comments.body:
Verified: line 9 omits the artifact operand. `gh attestation verify --help` gives `gh attestation verify [<file-path> | oci://<image-uri>] [--owner | --repo]`, and the recorded working run (`codegraph-evaluation.md:121`) names the tarball. The correct form is `gh attestation verify <file> -R colbymchenry/codegraph`, once per downloaded file, with gh authenticated.

No code change applied in this cycle: the automated diagnosis finished `partial` (calibrated confidence below the auto-apply bar), so the fix is left for a person to apply. The release-monitor spec this brief produced already verifies each of the 5 files, so only this planning record is affected. Leaving the thread open.
